shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'calendar|date' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3 peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar CalendarView; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components | rg 'docs/INDEX|README|Calendar.*d.ts|index.d.ts' | head -80; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils | rg 'docs/INDEX|README' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; rg -n -C 3 'loadLocale|setLocale|ThemeProviderProps|lang\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -100; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'Typography|text-primary|--g-color-base|--g-spacing|Button view|Button' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -140; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | head -50; rg -n 'dateTime\\(|format\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/App.css src/main.tsx package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short'
